notes: No contradiction of the existing entry: the existing definition says 'progressive' and the overview says symptoms can become constant, but the NHS says the condition does not necessarily get worse; the final article states only the NHS position plus 'in more severe cases symptoms can be continuous' (NHS 111 Wales via Versus Arthritis search) and does not use the word progressive, nor MedlinePlus's contrary 'most likely get worse' line. nhs.uk and NHS England decision-aid pages were mostly returned as titles/summaries; several attributions come from blended summaries (self-help leaflets, NSAID tablets plus stomach protection, NICE NG226 statements which came from a draft evidence review and the guideline recommendations page). The NHS England decision aid and North Yorkshire CCG documents were not returned by any search, so all claims from them were removed and the references dropped. No doses or cut-offs in final text. Weak points for a human reviewer: NSAID-tablet/stomach-protection sentence and heat/cold leaflet sentence rely on blended summaries.
